reviewed_by: Claude (py-test-rot Misc A); selection reviewed against the diff by the implementing agent; the subagent start race independently validated by a separate subagent
reason: Product: SubagentService.start (chat_subagents.py) checked the parent's children for the same idempotency key and against the sibling limit, then awaited plans, activity, goals and the harness session before storing; since #939 those awaits yield, so concurrent starts with one key could create two children and concurrent starts could exceed the sibling limit. start() now holds a per-parent lock through the write, with the MCP catalog read before the lock. Tests: twelve tests/v3 files left stale by #939 are repaired (async stubs/helpers, off-loop sync check, restoration barrier after #1114's locked recheck, migration 0050 irreversible since #1114, report PDFs need a memory-managed runner since 64e0379). test_mcp_catalog_reads covers the race; the subagent suites cover the lock.
exclusions: test_notebooks, test_operator_help, test_packaging and test_product_knowledge carry partial repairs but still fail on separate product issues (notebook inventory blocks the loop; help keywords; conditional imports; a docs edit moved a help passage), so they are not selected. PostgreSQL variants skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL.
